title: Require complete executed release gates and immutable admission evidence under policy v6
goal: Execute complete release admission gates (format, default-licenses, native-advisories, all-features-policy, workspace-clippy, workspace-tests, production-build, unsafe-measurement, unsafe-ratchet, native-provenance) against exact candidate commits and bind raw logs, exact argv, outer test counts, and external coordinator authorization bytes in a mandatory susi/complete-release-gates/v1 receipt while rejecting partial, stale, tampered, or unrooted receipts (landed in 2f4c65a9f4dc6d422e3948adde84369b797eec3e with deterministic promotion refinement in 0a21547853749649f41ef19df1c24c425045723b).
notes: Landed in 2f4c65a9f4dc6d422e3948adde84369b797eec3e across xtask/src/bin/local-release.rs and xtask/src/complete_release_gates.rs (with deterministic gate promotion follow-up in 0a21547853749649f41ef19df1c24c425045723b and shared xtask library consolidation in 089bbb44f3060eda15a39e2d84d4e44d23f73e8a). All three prerequisite tasks (T-PROVENANCE-1, T-UNSAFECOMPLETE-1, T-OPTIONALLICENSE-1) are closed in .agents/tasks/done/.

reuse.justification: Integrated policy-v6 complete release gate verification directly into xtask/src/bin/local-release.rs and xtask/src/complete_release_gates.rs while reusing xtask::native_json, xtask::native_test_counts, and xtask::trusted_sysroot.
